product_metadata.title: CHUN YI Stretch Ottoman Slipcover Rectangle Storage Stool Cover with Elastic Bottom, Checks Spandex Jacquard Fabric (Large, Orange)
features: SIZE：Large size is suitable for ottomans that are 37.4"-50.4" in length, 11.8"-16.5" in width and 15"-16.5" in height. Please check your sofa size carefully before purchasing.
ADVANTAGES: CHUN YI ottoman cover can wrap your ottoman well and offer your ottoman a new look. Various adorable colors are available to decorate your ottoman.
Fabric: 85% polyester 15% spandex fabric makes our ottoman covers more stretchy and durable, ensuring both good function and comfort.
INSTALLATION: We provide video of installation for you. The installation process is really simple and easy to operate.

TIPS: With a brief style and appealing colors, our slipcovers match well for your most different styles of furniture and decoration. Colors may slightly differ due to the diverse light and monitor display.
